title: Understanding the Expression
text: The expression $$\left(y_i-\operatorname{\sigma}\left(X_i {\theta}^t\right)\right) X_i$$ is part of the gradient descent update rule. It involves the difference between the actual outcome $$y_i$$ and the predicted probability $$\operatorname{\sigma}\left(X_i {\theta}^t\right)$$, multiplied by the feature vector $$X_i$$.
